objects.description: Enumeration of per-voxel state used by the voxel grid: FREE (known free), UNKNOWN (state not observed/unknown), and MARKED (known occupied).

3D voxel occupancy grid storing per-(x,y) columns as 32-bit integers with paired bit-planes: lower 16 bits for known/unknown flags per z, upper 16 bits for marked/occupied flags per z. Provides voxel and column queries, modification (mark/clear), and raytracing utilities using a 3D Bresenham traversal. Size_z must be <= 16. Memory is owned by the class (data_ and optionally costmap for 2D projection). Logger is used for bounds/debug messages. Inner helper functors implement per-step actions during raytracing.

functions.description: Marks a voxel (x,y,z) as known and occupied, then evaluates the number of marked cells in the column against marked_threshold. 0 <= y < size_y_
0 <= z < size_z_ (size_z_ <= 16)

functions.name: nav2_voxel_grid::VoxelGrid::raytraceLine
functions.signature:
template <class ActionType>
inline void nav2_voxel_grid::VoxelGrid::raytraceLine(ActionType at, double x0, double y0, double z0, double x1, double y1, double z1, unsigned int max_length = UINT_MAX, unsigned int min_length = 0)
functions.description: Traverses the 3D grid along the line from (x0,y0,z0) to (x1,y1,z1) using a Bresenham-like algorithm and applies the provided action functor at each visited cell. If the line length is less than min_length, nothing is done. max_length limits the number of dominant-axis steps processed. Handles the degenerate case where start and end are the same by processing a single voxel.
requirements: ActionType must be callable as at(unsigned int offset, unsigned int z_mask) and perform the desired operation using the linear offset and z-bit mask
min_length must be <= Euclidean distance between endpoints to have effect; when distance is 0, exactly one voxel is processed
max_length caps the number of steps; values of 0 result in only the final at(offset,z_mask) call at the current position
Coordinates should correspond to grid indices; internal casts to int and floor-like behavior are used
